info.name: Azure Monitor Azure Application Insights API
info.description:
Access Application Insights telemetry data including requests, dependencies, exceptions, traces, and custom events for application performance monitoring. Query data using Kusto Query Language (KQL).

Contact Support:
 Name: Microsoft Azure Support
